name: Kimpton Grand Roatan Resort & Spa
insider_take: This stunning beachfront sanctuary sits on one of the Caribbean's most pristine stretches of sand, where world-class diving meets barefoot luxury just steps from the Mesoamerican Reef.
whats_special: The resort occupies prime real estate on West Bay Beach, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches. As Roatan's first luxury resort, it offers direct access to the second-largest barrier reef system in the world. The property features Roatan's only overwater bungalows and maintains the island's most comprehensive marine conservation program, including sea turtle nesting site protection.
pro_tip: Book diving excursions early morning when visibility is crystal clear - the resort's house reef drops to 60 feet just offshore, making it perfect for both beginners and certified divers.
dont_miss: The nightly sea turtle releases (seasonal), snorkeling at nearby Blue Channel where tropical fish congregate, and sunset cocktails at the overwater bar. The resort's signature spa treatments using indigenous Honduran coffee and cacao are exclusively available here and nowhere else on the island.
pros: Premium beachfront location on pristine West Bay Beach
World-class diving and snorkeling access to Mesoamerican Reef
Full-service spa with tropical wellness treatments
Kimpton's signature boutique hospitality and personalized service
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
Limited nightlife and dining options outside resort
